We don’t get keys to the school buildings. Again, we don’t run the school district, we see that it is properly run. Building administrators have keys to the buildings, but we don’t. So don’t call us at 9:30 p.m. when the building is locked and your child left his math book in the locker. 9. We don’t get paid a salary ! More often than you’d think, we have to educate people about the fact that being a school board member is an unpaid gig. There are some school districts in some states, including Florida, Virginia, North Carolina and
California that pay school board members, but not in New Jersey. Not now, not ever. SCHOOL LEADER N O V E M B E R | D E C E M B E R 2 0 1 8 25
